candidate: Lazily compute the unchanged H prealignment inverse once per native pair region, at the same first-use position; no other production change
scope: Local variable only, no cross-region/frame retention or mutable arrays in output
performance_gate: All three full-controller total wall medians AND means strictly improve; output byte-equivalence everywhere; retain all samples. Reject and restore if any case regresses. One fixed serial AB/BA comparison only, no rerun to pass.
correctness: Preserve first-use/empty/pre-projection/singular exception order, finally cleanup, native and fallback dispatch, source arguments and safety policies. Native actual match counts stay identical.
baseline: Only pair source differs, H/I/primitives shared unchanged. Use unmodified loader; no cloned H/I identity remapping.
after_gate: If fail, snapshot candidate then restore exact baseline; if pass, run bounded compatibility replay and regression before accept. No candidate retuning.
